text_to_image_prompt: Mature adult man, swept-back wavy dark brown hair with subtle gray temples, brown eyes, strong angular jaw and brows, clean shaven, fit lean waist, charcoal wool three-piece suit, white shirt, dark tie, black Oxford shoes. Single frontal eye-level head-and-shoulder portrait, neutral expression. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied approved casting sheet by extracting ONLY the specified actor into one standalone photorealistic head-and-upper-torso identity portrait. This is the EXACT SAME approved person, not recasting. Preserve their precise facial anatomy, eye shape/color, age, hairline, haircut/color, skin tone, characteristic features, clothing and accessories. Change only the pose/camera and background: strict front view, camera exactly at eye level, zero head yaw/pitch/roll, eyes level and directly facing the lens, head upright, shoulders level and square to camera. Neutral relaxed expression retaining natural character. Even soft frontal daylight, natural detailed skin, no beautification, no de-aging, no CGI. Flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background edge-to-edge, no gray, no beige, no gradient, no vignette, no shadows on the backdrop. Single person centered, whole hair/head visible with white margin above, upper torso to mid chest, portrait 3:4 composition. No hands, text, labels, borders, other faces or panels. Do not borrow any feature from any other person in the sheet. Target ONLY cell 03, TOP ROW THIRD COLUMN: mature dark-brown-haired clean-shaven man in charcoal three-piece suit, white shirt and dark tie. Keep his distinctive broad facial structure, subtly lined eyes, slightly graying temples, calm severe mouth, and reference hair volume.
reproduction_note: 独立提示词为成图重建描述；严格身份一致需同时参考已确认全身图与原始肖像。实际尺寸按PNG记录，不冒称2K或4K；背面细节为生成补全。
